sections.title: 1. Package Contents & Architecture
sections.content: The **[C&C] Vow Collar Suite** is a modern, lag-free Second Life BDSM, FinDom, and RLV management system. Unlike older OpenCollar forks that rely on heavy HTTP polling or 50+ scripts, the Vow Collar runs entirely on optimized native LSL with **LinksetData persistence** and Second Life Experience auto-attach permissions.

sections.title: 2. Quick Start & Locking Protocols
sections.content:
### Step 1: Wear the Collar & Accept Permissions
Right-click > Add the collar. When prompted to accept Experience permissions for 'Control & Chaos', click **Yes**.

### Step 2: Lock Ceremony & Passkey Setup
Touch the collar or type `/22 menu`. Select **Lock Collar**. The wearer or Mistress sets a private 4-digit passkey.

### Step 3: Direct Debit & Air Tax Activation
In the **FinDom > Air Tax** menu, the submissive grants debit permission. The Mistress can configure a daily or per-minute tax.

sections.title: 3. RLV Features & Stealth Props
sections.content:
The Vow Collar communicates directly with Firestorm / standard RLV viewers to enforce realistic discipline:
- **Vision Blinding & Blindfolds**
- **Chat Restriction & Force Gagging**
- **Inventory & Detach Locks**
- **Proximity Sit & Force Kneel on Pedestals**
